A legal battle unfolds, threatening a legacy of social activism.

Ben & Jerry’s Foundation says it will shut down amid legal dispute with parent company
Evidence: funding cut, governance dispute, mission threatened
#BenAndJerrys #Philanthropy

The Ben & Jerry's Foundation states it will cease operations by year-end due to its parent company, Magnum (Unilever), cutting off funding and evicting staff. This action jeopardizes $600,000 in annual grants and 40 years of progressive mission work.
